sections.Profile:
"Wishing Well," released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in September 1955, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. The game features a whimsical wishing well theme, with the backglass depicting a young girl tossing a coin into a well, surrounded by playful cherubs.
